WITH customer_first AS (
  SELECT
    customer_key,
    MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  GROUP BY
    customer_key
), sales_2024 AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_key,
    s.net_amount,
    cf.first_order_date
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
  JOIN customer_first AS cf
    ON s.customer_key = cf.customer_key
  WHERE
    s.order_date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE)
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN first_order_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    THEN 'Customers older than 2024'
    ELSE 'Customers who first bought in 2024'
  END AS customer_group,
  SUM(net_amount) AS revenue
FROM sales_2024
GROUP BY
  customer_group
ORDER BY
  customer_group
